name: Summit AZ - Keyword Targeting Audit 2026-10-01
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Read-only audit of 185 indexable pages and posts: each page's Rank Math primary focus keyword compared with the searches it actually ranks for in the GSC web UI (Sep 2 to 29 and Jul 1 to Sep 29). Workbook sheets include a Summary and a Conflicts list.

# Results
- Primary keyword set on 180 of 185 (missing: /blog/, privacy, terms, /repiping/, /home-warranty-plumbing/). No two pages share a primary keyword.
- Intent match: 174 yes, 2 no (both blog posts).
- Correct URL ranking for its keyword: 57 pages. Another URL ranks instead: 28 pages.
- Keyword not yet visible in GSC: 95 pages (mostly low-traffic city pages). Zero impressions: 39 pages in 28 days, 14 in 3 months.
- Cannibalization: 17 pages clearly, 51 slightly; 137 searches show two or more Summit pages.
- Caveat: 56 pages were rewritten after Sep 24, so re-check after Oct 24.

# Conflicts (top items)
1. High: emergency searches land on the Tempe plumbing hub ("emergency plumber tempe" 2,203 impressions at 28.7 vs 18 on the Tempe emergency page; the hub is 21% of site impressions with 0 clicks).
2. High: tankless pages rank for "water heater repair/replacement [city]" in 5 cities while water heater pages get almost nothing.
3. High: "drain cleaning mesa az" goes to /drain-cleaning/, not the Mesa page (3 impressions in 3 months).
4. Medium: Mesa sewer searches split across three pages (Mesa page leads).
5. Medium: no-city head terms rotate between city pages (normal).
6. Medium: slab leak searches split between /slab-leaks/ and city leak pages.
7. Medium: blog posts holding service keywords (signs of a slab leak; trenchless sewer repair).

# Decisions and status
- Done Oct 1: the two blog focus keyword changes (row 7 and the trenchless post).
- Waiting on Kim (handoff): tankless pages strictly tankless plus links to city water heater pages, /drain-cleaning/ link to the Mesa drain page, Tempe hub link to Tempe emergency page. The Tempe fix depends on the emergency-search strategy call.
